# tack — agent guide

<!-- ops:identity start — generated by ops-docs; edit identity.toml -->
Harness homes, declared links, settings, and session-state hygiene

Authority: `docs/specs/2026-10-06-residue-design.md`
<!-- ops:identity end -->

## Setup

Run `just setup` once per checkout. It installs the git hooks and harness-state
clean filter, and creates `local/codex/rules/`. Work settings under `local/` come
from another configured host; setup creates directories, not private settings.

## Gates

Run `just test` before committing: it runs the agent-tool suite and the hook/tool
suite. There is no CI or pre-push suite here. The pre-commit hook checks the guide
identity regions with `tools/ops-docs check` and refuses staged paths under `local/`.
`just docs` regenerates the identity regions from `identity.toml`.

From main, `just link` previews home changes and `just link-check` checks convergence.
`just mods` validates and tests the Claude Code mods when the Claude CLI is available.
The generated global Projects block is checked by lore.

## Layout

- `links.toml` and `tools/harness-links`: real harness homes, declared home links and
  their reconciliation through the tasks project registry.
- `claude/`, `codex/` and `local/`: harness settings, hooks and untracked host state.
  `claude/mods/` holds Claude Code function-hook plugins.
- `.githooks/`: config-state filtering, Codex trust preservation and commit checks.
- `facts/capabilities.toml` and `tools/harness-facts`: what each harness has been shown
  to do, with the record behind each value. The tool is the only reader.
- `agents/skills/session-logs/`: session-store guidance. `agents/bin/` keeps
  session-episodes, wake-judge, their tests, and links to tools owned by flows.
- `tools/session-archive` and `systemd/user/`: transcript capture and pruning.
- `docs/`: residue specs and plans, including two frozen profiles documents retained
  for closed task references. `tools/ops-docs` is vendored from ops.

The global instructions, profiles and general skill corpus live in lore. This root
file is tack's project guide; home links to global instructions target lore.

## Rules

- Change home routing in `links.toml`. Apply with `just link --apply` from main only;
  linking to a worktree would leave live harnesses dependent on temporary storage.
  Targets must exist in their registered owner checkouts before an apply.
- Keep `local/` untracked. It contains work settings, rules and saved Codex trust;
  publishing it would expose host and work state.
- Treat model picks, effort and Codex trust as live state. The clean filter and trust
  hooks preserve their contract; avoid stashing or overwriting main's harness configs
  merely to clear a modified marker. See README.md for the recovery behavior.
- Enable session-archive timers only on a host with its archive configuration and
  backup destination. Archive tests must use temporary stores rather than live logs.
- Read a capability fact through `tools/harness-facts` (`get`, `list`, or its `lookup`
  as a module), never by parsing the file. Edit the file in a worktree; `unknown` is an
  answer and never a default. README.md has the re-probing procedure.
